categories.name: One economics specialization
categories.note: The two compulsory modules of one of five economics specializations (6 ECTS each, 12 ECTS). Both are offered for Economic Behavior and Governance (Grundlagen der Oekonometrie and Einfuehrung in die Verhaltensoekonomik). Digital Business, Finance, Accounting, Controlling and Taxation, and Management, Innovation und Marketing each offer only one of the two modules this semester.
